name: bluechip Money in and out
description: [bluechip] Deposits, withdrawals, the faucet, unexplained adjustments and the paper operator's balance.

query.mpl:
`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.deposits`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align using sum
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.deposits.value`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align using sum
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.withdrawals.value`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align using sum
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.reconcile.unexplained`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align using sum
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.deposits`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.deposits.value`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.withdrawals`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `outcome` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.withdrawals.value`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `outcome` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.faucet.mints`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `outcome` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.faucet.value`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.reconcile.unexplained`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `asset` using sum

charts.name: Operator balance (paper, ETH; top up under 0.1)

query.mpl:
`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.paper.operator_balance`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using last
| group using sum
